willow_exp_grove_saved_by_cutting.title: What Could Still Be Saved
willow_exp_grove_saved_by_cutting.interpretation: The protagonist removes the visibly corrupted roots and preserves the grove at a real cost. Willow accepts decisive stewardship without pretending that the lost growth was irrelevant.

willow_exp_wisdom_used_in_world.title: The Pattern Used Without Her
willow_exp_wisdom_used_in_world.interpretation: The protagonist uses Willow's slow-pattern cognition on an external problem Willow did not solve for them, identifying the visible rot as a symptom and restoring the underlying flow.

elara_exp_inventory_plausible_model.title: The Plausible Inventory
elara_exp_inventory_plausible_model.interpretation: The protagonist accepts the inventory's most plausible linear explanation while preserving the contradictory entries for later review. Elara accepts the conservative inference.

elara_exp_insight_reopens_inventory.title: The Model Reopened
elara_exp_insight_reopens_inventory.interpretation: The protagonist notices that two individually plausible records cannot both be true and reopens the explanatory model rather than defending the first coherent account.
